prices_csv.description: Optional absolute path to an offline adjusted-close CSV (date, stocks, benchmark). Empty uses Yahoo Finance. No simulated fallback.

exposes_tools.name: barra.series
exposes_tools.description: Read computed daily factor metrics for chart.series. Beta, Momentum and ResidualVol are cumulative regression coefficients in percentage points. Forecast and Realized21D are annualized volatility percentages. EqualWeight starts at 100. Use fields=[close] and period=day. Frozen mode excludes the latest date.

exposes_tools.name: barra.start
exposes_tools.description: Start or update this Track's daily US price-factor study using beta, momentum and residual volatility. The default illustrative 30-stock universe has selection and survivorship bias, with SPY as benchmark. Queues a calculation and daily updates.

symbols.description: US Yahoo ticker symbols, uppercase. All must have sufficient complete history.

exposes_tools.name: barra.status
exposes_tools.description: Read this Track's factor study settings, phase, error and last successful result. Check the data date.

exposes_tools.name: barra.refresh
exposes_tools.description: Queue one recalculation for a running study. Concurrent requests coalesce.

exposes_tools.name: barra.stop
exposes_tools.description: Stop daily updates and clear pending work. Retains published results and files.
